profile_import.subtitle: Upload a PDF or DOCX. Extraction runs in your browser — the file never leaves this device.
profile_import.dropzone.hint: PDF or DOCX up to 10 MB
profile_import.result.title: Extracted content
profile_import.result.hint: Review and edit the extracted Markdown below — fix any joined lines or misplaced formatting before sending it to the AI.
profile_import.result.chunk_hint: Long documents are split into sections before extraction. Use `#`/`##`/`###` for headings and `-` or `*` for bullets — 4th-level headings may not chunk correctly. Numbered lists stay together to preserve order; if one gets long enough that it likely won't fit in a single AI call, break it into sub-sections so no entries get dropped.
